title: James Packer sells Aspen mansion for $42.7 million
summary_full: Australian billionaire James Packer has successfully offloaded his opulent Aspen mansion for $42.7 million, a staggering return on his 2013 investment of $15.6 million. The breathtaking Tuscan-inspired estate has been acquired by tech entrepreneur Alex Davis and his wife, Lindsay, who are no strangers to the Aspen community. With Packer having moved on from the U.S.
